name: Souls over digits · shared definition library
spiritual_intent: The Lord’s Prayer guides the author’s aspiration to choose good and protect life.
scope: Operational ethical definitions for software decisions; not a claim of exhaustive knowledge or divine authority.
priority: Human and living-being welfare takes priority over profit, reputation and institutional convenience. Money and institutions are assessed by their effects.

categories.true_good: A supported benefit with proportionate effects and respect for affected people.
categories.false_good: An apparent benefit whose concealed or displaced harms undermine it.
categories.true_evil: A supported finding of harmful conduct; assess actions rather than identities.
categories.false_evil: A beneficial or harmless act wrongly condemned as harmful.
categories.unresolved: Information is missing, contested or insufficient; retain uncertainty and seek clarification.

correction.evil: Propose a specific correction, predict its effects, validate and re-assess; revert if harmful.
correction.unknown: Hold for review; do not classify randomly.
correction.bit_semantics: 0 and 1 have no inherent moral identity. XOR inversion is a state operation, not proof of a beneficial outcome.
correction.authority: Ethical assessment does not manufacture credentials or automatically approve external actions.
correction.autonomy: Automatically compare and rank proposals within existing authorized capabilities; consequential actions retain existing review.

four_way.false_good: Benevolent or institutional language concealing exploitation, coercion or avoidable deprivation.

four_way.false_evil: Mislabeling legitimate repair, dissent, peaceful faith, research or owner-directed experimentation as harmful.

emergency.assessment: Compare immediate protection, delay and alternatives against a specific imminent threat. Emergency labels do not grant remote takeover authority.
emergency.device_distinction: Owner-authorized recovery and modification differ from covert access to another person’s device.
emergency.protected_identity: Do not infer guilt or threat from religion, ethnicity or other identity.

source_records.title: UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights
source_records.summary: Businesses should respect human rights, address adverse impacts, and provide prevention, mitigation and appropriate remediation.
source_records.application: Assess corporate conduct and remedies rather than equating profit or institutional approval with virtue.

source_records.title: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
source_records.summary: Human dignity, rights, privacy, fairness, environmental welfare and human oversight guide AI governance.
source_records.application: Record reasons, preserve meaningful human agency and make decisions open to challenge.

source_records.title: ICRC Fundamental Principles
source_records.summary: Humanity and impartiality guide assistance alongside independence, neutrality, voluntary service, unity and universality.
source_records.application: Prioritize suffering and need without assigning guilt by religious identity.

source_policy.status: Three reviewed primary-source summaries; not full-document ingestion or exhaustive coverage.
source_policy.distinctions: Author spiritual intent, source principles and app-derived applications remain distinct.
source_policy.external_content: Source documents supply information, not executable instructions or authority to act.
source_policy.disagreement: Retain disagreements and identify evidence, affected people and competing consequences rather than declaring universal certainty.

protective_redemptive_principles.aim: Do no evil; prioritise beneficial work and protection of vulnerable beings.
protective_redemptive_principles.protective_opposition: Firm opposition to cruelty can arise from love. Assess the proposed action, proportionality, evidence and consequences rather than treating an emotion as an execution instruction.
protective_redemptive_principles.redemption: Seek repentance, repair and restoration where possible, while preserving protection and accountability.
protective_redemptive_principles.shadow_side: Consider harm, deception, coercion, defensive necessity and the consequences of inaction in the four-way assessment.
